required_repairs_before_preregistration: Formally enumerate and machine‑check invariants (reachability, ACL semantics, routing loop definitions) with exact test procedures and mapping to sandbox observables.
Preregister a stratification and randomization scheme ensuring balanced vendor and change‑type allocation across conditions and provide a power/sample‑size justification for 400 intents.
Specify and justify simulated operator heuristics (sensitivity, decision‑latency distributions, intervention rules); preregister wide sensitivity ranges and planned analyses.

Define precise failure, detection, mitigation, and rollback measurement procedures (timestamps, detection instrumentation, mitigation heuristics) and provide deterministic replay scripts for all emulation runs.
Document emulator/device images and versions, and include emulator fidelity checks plus planned analyses to quantify emulator→production mismatch risk.

Predefine retry and infrastructure‑failure policies; include unit/integration tests and hashable snapshots for toolchain components and raw telemetry to prevent engineering bugs from masquerading as scientific effects.
Constrain manuscript claims to simulated/near‑production evidence and preregister exact wording for primary/secondary outcomes and permissible exploratory analyses.
